title: Parker O-Ring Handbook, catalog ORD 5700A/US (2001 edition)
supports: Sizes, 'Parker Series 2-XXX O-Ring Sizes' (PDF p. 227): 2-010 = AS 568A -010, nominal 1/4 x 3/8 x 1/16 in; actual ID .239 +-.005 in, W .070 +-.003 in; basic volume .0037 cu in; metric ID 6,07 +-0,13, W 1,78 +-0,08 mm

Design Chart 4-1, Industrial Static Seal Glands (p. 4-5, PDF p. 88), sizes 004-050: gland depth L .050-.052 in, squeeze .015-.023 in (22-32 %), diametral clearance .002-.005 in, groove width G .093-.098 in (no Parbak), groove radius .005-.015 in; note (c): reduce maximum diametral clearance 50 % with silicone or fluorosilicone O-rings

Design Table 4-1, gland dimensions for industrial static seals (p. 4-6, PDF p. 89), 2-010: mean OD (ref) .379; male gland bore A .375 +.002, groove B-1 .275; female gland tube OD B .250 +.000/-.002, groove A-1 .350, throat D .252 (groove width from Design Chart 4-1)

2.2.17 Silicone Rubber (VMQ) (p. 2-9, PDF p. 21): low tensile strength, poor tear and wear resistance; heat resistance to 232 C, cold flexibility to -59 C; physiologically neutral; compatible with water
3.1.5 Lubrication (PDF p. 53): Super-O-Lube is a high-viscosity silicone oil usable on all rubber polymers, including silicones, which 'require special consideration'
note: Parker publishes the handbook (current edition at https://discover.parker.com/Parker-ORing-Handbook-ORD-5700, which needs a form); the copy read is the 2001 edition hosted by the University of Michigan.
